description_en: Queries the details of a logical database
name: GetLogicDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logical database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the ID of the logical database
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑库ID（DatabaseId），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: db_id

LogicDatabase.description_en: The details of the logical database

Alias.description_en: The alias of the logical database

DatabaseId.description_en: The ID of the logical database

DbType.description_en: The database engine. For more information about the valid values of the DbType parameter, see [DbType parameter]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html）
DbType.description_zh: 数据库类型。返回值请参见[DbType参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198106.html）

EnvType.description_en:
The type of the environment to which the database belongs. Valid values:

product: production environment
dev: development environment
pre: pre-release environment
test: test environment
sit: system integration testing (SIT) environment
uat: user acceptance testing (UAT) environment
pet: stress testing environment
stag: staging environment
EnvType.description_zh:
环境类型，返回值如下：
product：生产环境
dev：开发环境
pre：预发环境
test：测试环境
sit：SIT环境
uat：UAT环境
pet：压测环境
stag：STAG环境

Logic.description_en: Indicates whether the database is a logical database. The return value is true
Logic.description_zh: 是否为逻辑库，返回值为true

SchemaName.description_en: The name of the logical database

SearchName.description_en: The name that is used to search for the logical database

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
